mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cl_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE()
SELECT IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) FROM cl_order WHERE DATE(create_time) = CURDATE() AND status IN ('1', '2', '3')
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cl_goods WHERE status = '0'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM cl_order WHERE status IN ('0', '1', '2')

SELECT order_id as id, order_no as orderNo, total_amount as amount, total_amount as totalAmount, status as statusCode, CASE status WHEN '0' THEN '待支付' WHEN '1' THEN '已支付' WHEN '2' THEN '制作中' WHEN '3' THEN '已完成' WHEN '4' THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END as status, DATE_FORMAT(create_time, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') as createTime FROM cl_order ORDER BY create_time DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT goods_id as id, goods_name as name, stock FROM cl_goods WHERE stock < 10 AND status = '0' ORDER BY stock ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT DATE(create_time) as date, COUNT(*) as order_count, IFNULL(SUM(total_amount), 0) as sales_amount FROM cl_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY) AND status IN ('1', '2', '3') GROUP BY DATE(create_time) ORDER BY date

SELECT CASE status WHEN '0' THEN '待支付' WHEN '1' THEN '已支付' WHEN '2' THEN '制作中' WHEN '3' THEN '已完成' WHEN '4' THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知' END as status_name, COUNT(*) as count FROM cl_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) GROUP BY status

SELECT g.goods_id as id, g.goods_name as name, IFNULL(SUM(oi.quantity), 0) as sales_count FROM cl_goods g LEFT JOIN cl_order_item oi ON g.goods_id = oi.goods_id LEFT JOIN cl_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id WHERE o.create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY) AND o.status IN ('1', '2', '3') GROUP BY g.goods_id, g.goods_name ORDER BY sales_count DESC LIMIT 10

SELECT g.goods_name as goodsName, g.goods_price as goodsPrice, g.stock, g.status, IFNULL(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status IN ('1', '2', '3') THEN oi.quantity ELSE 0 END), 0) as salesCount FROM cl_goods g LEFT JOIN cl_order_item oi ON g.goods_id = oi.goods_id LEFT JOIN cl_order o ON oi.order_id = o.order_id GROUP BY g.goods_id, g.goods_name, g.goods_price, g.stock, g.status ORDER BY salesCount DESC, g.sort_order ASC LIMIT 5

SELECT COUNT(*) as total_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '0' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as pending_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '1' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as processing_count, SUM(CASE WHEN status = '2' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) as completed_count FROM cl_custom_order WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 30 DAY)
SELECT COUNT(*) as total_chats, COUNT(DISTINCT session_id) as unique_sessions, AVG(response_time) as avg_response_time FROM cl_assistant_chat WHERE create_time >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL 7 DAY)
